title: On every octahedral knot sphere, each separated Fano atom acts as its line in exactly one class of its handle and then holds a unit
subject: The rule that decides which Fano atoms of a grown knot sphere hold its floor dissonance, for every octahedral knot sphere
conclusion: For every octahedral knot sphere with separated Fano atoms, each atom acts as its replaced line in exactly one of its handle's four classes; if all act no state satisfies every line, and otherwise every acting atom holds a unit of the floor dissonance. Proved computer-assisted: two lemmas by hand, a finite local check and a classification of line neighbourhoods.
